description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Space Wolves EYE OF THE PACK (Saga of the Great Wolf, 1 CP) in its own Shooting phase — WP-S3. Fixture sw11e_s3_active (P1 Space Wolves ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sw11e_s3_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Space Wolves player gets all three Space Wolves detachments (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, the Ork player has 0 CP (no Ork stratagem windows — not under test), straight to the phase under test. The shooting panel's unit pick selects the Wulfen (ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY) and opens unit_selected_to_shoot; a real click on 'Use on Wulfen' spends 1 CP; the Wulfen shoot the Gretchin and the resolved wound dice block names Eye of the Pack (re-roll wound rolls of 1 and 2 — the new WoundModifier.REROLL_ONES_TWOS).
